title: CTA Link Category Tiny
description: Tiny-size uppercase category link with CTA colour default. Hover and active states change to CTA orange.

styles.css: &{transition: color 200ms ease;} & a{transition: color 200ms ease;} & a:hover{color: var(--wp--preset--color--cta-500); text-decoration: underline;} & a:active{color: var(--wp--preset--color--cta-500); text-decoration: underline;} & a:focus-visible{color: var(--wp--preset--color--cta-500); outline: 2px solid var(--wp--preset--color--focus-background); outline-offset: 2px;}
